item.title: One injured in second Friday night shooting on North Ardenwood Drive
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; Baton Rouge Police are investigating a Friday night shooting on North Ardenwood Drive that left one injured.&nbsp;According to the department, the shooting occurred around 9:45 p.m., shortly after another shooting at 6:54 p.m. injured a 13 -year-old inside a home.&nbsp;&nbsp;Police said the 33-year-old victim was transported to a local hospital with a gunshot injury.&nbsp;The investigation remains ongoing.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Houma-area fire department responds to three 'major' fires Friday night, early Saturday morning
item.description: HOUMA - The Bayou Cane Fire Protection District responded to three "major" incidents Friday night and early Saturday morning.The first fire happened around 7:30 p.m. following a two-vehicle accident on West Park Avenue near the intersection of Coteau Road when the fuel tank on one vehicle ruptured. item.title: Infant gorilla at Audubon Zoo dies shortly after being born

item.title: Early voting on Monday suspended for Assumption, Iberville parishes due to winter storm
item.description: NAPOLEONVILLE - The Secretary of State announced that early voting for the Feb. 7 special legislative primary election will be suspended for Monday due to an incoming winter storm.Six parishes are affected, including Assumption and Iberville parishes. Calcasieu, Jefferson Davis, Orleans and St. Bernard are also affected.Early voting will resume on Tuesday, Jan. 27, at 8:30 a.m.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Almost 12,000 flights canceled as major winter storm bears down across much of the U.S.
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY (AP) &mdash; Almost 12,000 flights across the U.S. set to take off over the weekend were canceled as a monster storm started to wreak havoc Saturday across much of the country and threatened to knock out power for days and snarl major roadways with dangerous ice.Roughly 140 million people, or more than 40% of the U.S. population, were under a winter storm warning from New Mexico to New England. item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; Shelters around the capital region are preparing to help those in need of a place to stay during the incoming winter storm.Saint Vincent De Paul opened its emergency center this weekend. item.title: BRPD: 32-year-old man dead after Friday night shooting on Virginia Street
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A 32-year-old man is dead after a shooting on Virginia Street, the Baton Rouge Police Department said.Officials said around 10 p.m. Friday night, they found Lathan Wheeler, 32, dead from a gunshot wound inside a residence in the 2100 block of Virginia Street.The motive and suspect are unknown at this time. The investigation is ongoing.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Libraries, Salvation Army, others open warming centers and shelters as freezing temperatures hit Capital Area
item.description: BATON ROUGE - As freezing temperatures approach the Capital Area, community organizations are stepping up to make sure those most vulnerable have a warm place to go.With winter weather pushing temperatures into the teens, local leaders are urging residents without reliable heat to seek shelter and take precautions against the dangerously cold conditions.Across East Baton Rouge Parish, the library system has opened several branches as designated warming centers. item.title: St. George Fire: Vehicle stuck in water on South Tiger Bend Road, Riverside Drive
item.description: ST. GEORGE - The St. George Fire Department said crews are working a vehicle stuck in water on South Tiger Bend Road near Riverside Drive.Officials said there is at least 10 inches of water on the roadway and barricades have been deployed.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments
